dataset.source: StatsAPI archived acquisition (boxscore_cache + pbp_cache, ~/workspace/tmp/bt_data), schedules pbp_cache/schedule_{2024,2025}.json

pit_rule: All simulator inputs, baseline inputs and rates for a game use only archived games with officialDate strictly before that game's officialDate. PA occurred_at = source game's officialDate 00:00 UTC; cutoff = prediction game's officialDate 00:00 UTC.
lineup_provenance: Official starting batting order (slots x00) and gamesStarted==1 starter from the official boxscore record; games lacking a complete 9-man order or a unique starter are excluded, never imputed.

fit_policy.league_context_fit_scope: hook surface + baserunning profile fit once per fold on the training window
fit_policy.batter_profile_scope: per game, expanding, strictly prior dates
